reviews.x: FAKE. Do not buy. The color is lighter than the real product, consistency is off and has a chemical smell to it that is way different than the real products smell. If you look close you can tell they tried to mimic the packaging but the kid is a darker purple and the sticker on the bottom is completely different compared to the real product. Also you can not return it.
My boyfriend bought this for me and when I found out how much he spent, I returned it. You can get this a lot cheaper ($27) at a store. This price is a rip off.

I bought the shade (on the left) "light-medium" last year, from this seller. Fast forward to 2.14.2020, I bought the exact same shade "light-medium" (on the right) from this seller - it's clearly not the same color. So disappointed.

reviews.t: Anyone who has used real Tarte products knows that all of their products smell amazing. This concealer smells like awful
reviews.x: This product is not the real thing. Anyone who has used real Tarte products knows that all of their products smell amazing. This concealer smells like awful chemicals. Don't buy it just because it's cheaper. It can be extremely dangerous!

reviews.t: Loved it, very easy to blend and great coverage ...
reviews.x: Loved it ,very easy to blend and great coverage in first layer, i dont find myself adding additional layer with yhis product, i find a little covers really well. I noticed the product is bigger than the usual concealer tubes so you get more product. I have an Olive skin tone i use this concealer in shade Medium.

reviews.t: Swapped label- not the shade that's advertised
reviews.x: I received genuine shape tape, but the color doesn't match the same shade I purchased directly from Tarte. It's labeled Light-Medium, but a side by side comparison with the ones I already have show the difference. The label on the shape tape from this seller was also off center, it looks like it's been swapped from a different tube.

Amazing concealer, can't say enough good things about it, it provides AMAZING, flawless coverage.  I have pretty dark under eye circles, (thanks MOM) so trust me when I say I have bought almost every concealer out there, Bobbie Brown, Clinique, Younique, It Cosmetics, Lancôme, and more, including every drug store brand out there. Unfortunately I had to return it because the shade of the one I received from the seller was darker than the one I was close to running out of that is bought from Ulta

I have the shade fair and am an NC20. It is light enough to highlight with out being stark. It is so brightening and I didn't even need to set it and my skin is oily!!! I am extremely imressed. It does have a light floral fragrance if you are sensitive to that, but it does dissipate quickly. Really lovely product!

reviews.t: Oxidized a lot, buy a shade lighter if you can.
reviews.x: I want to love this - it's demi-matte, looks clean, blends well, and seemed to be in my perfect shade!  And then ten minutes passed and it oxidized hardcore into a darker, more orange shade...  It's not really usable, and it doesn't come in lighter as far as I know. I'm bummed about it.

reviews.t: It blends better and doesn't sit in my wrinkles thus highlighting them
reviews.x: It's pricey, yes. BUT it lasts and lasts. My friend gave me this, and I think it lasted me almost a whole year. So I bought it this year. So, for 365 days of application, it's not overpriced. A little dab will do ya.  I used to use Covergirl sticks for under-eye application for years. Now, I use this. It blends better and doesn't sit in my wrinkles thus highlighting them.

reviews.t: Dries the living crap out of your skin
reviews.x: Dries the living crap out of your skin! I will say it might be great to use if you want something really set and permanent for the day or for a few hours. Use a nice primer.  Does not layer well. Has great coverage though!! Just not for me. :)

reviews.t: Coverage, smoothness and doesn’t rub off!
reviews.x: OMG...The search is over... hands down the best concealer I have ever used. I put it on in the am and it stays all day.  After it dries it’s soft to the touch.  When I wipe debris under my eye it doesn’t smear or rub off. Seriously the best.

reviews.t: Just order it on Ulta.com for $25
reviews.x: This is a great product but I got it on ulta.com for $25 and this is just a big rip off I mean come on, this is almost $40 JUST SAYING.......
I've tried to like this because everyone does but it creases like crazy on me (I only have one wrinkle under each eye) it's really thick on me. I just use it as an eyeshadow primer

reviews.t: it was lighter than expected but that was my bad for not choosing the correct shade
reviews.x: Luved this product, it was lighter than expected but that was my bad for not choosing the correct shade. I still found a way to make it work for my skin and feel like I'll definitely be buying again! (darker shade though).

reviews.t: Great under eye cover, but messy tube
reviews.x: I love this long lasting under eye cover - goes on smooth and doesn't accentuate fine lines under my eyes. It also does a great job covering up the dark circles under my eyes that are there no matter how much sleep I've had the night before. The only thing I wish they would change is the way the product leaks out around the top of the tube when you pull the applicator brush out.  It is super messy and I have to wipe it off constantly and it is such a waste of product.  If the manufacturer would

Miracle worker. I have bags (not dark), no visible wrinkles and everything is smooth and fresh looking when I use this. Easy to put on applicator. Did look a little dry/flackie after 12 hours...maybe use moisturizer before applying.  Would suggest to anyone!!
Amazing! You can’t see the circles under my eyes anymore. They used to be very dark and now they look great. It blends easily and doesn’t leave a cakey look. Use small amounts, it goes a long way.
I am in love with this product it covers everything and I will not use anything else but this product
My wife has been buying this for years. This one has separated and the print on the handle is rubbing off. Shes barely used it maybe 6x. Feel like it’s prob fake.
I did not like this concealer for myself. It was very thick. I recommend Tarte creaseless concealer instead! I gave 1 star because it does conceal, just thick.
Applies smooth and runs in well but the top leaks when you close it. Personally prefer the smaller tube so that it doesn’t leak.

It's very good concealer, but it was lighter than intended. That might be because this is really intended for contouring and not spot concealing, but it's light enough that I get a bit of a ghost look if applied to thickly.
The one I received was supposed to be the same shade as what I ran out if. It’s clearly at least one shade lighter, and the consistency is off. It’s greasy.

Full coverage concealer with little to no creasing, I can see why this is so many people's holy grail.  I find its ingredients to not be so good for under eye skin since it has a LOT of fragrance and after a whole day of wearing it my skin feels dry as heck (and I have OILY skin!) . I'm lately using Too Faced Born This Way full coverage concealer and find it to be way better.  More emolient, a more "watery" creamy consistency, doesn't crease, easier to blend, and it's half an ounce for the price

claims.text: Several reviewers suspect the product is fake or not genuine, citing off colors, chemical smells, and mismatched labels.
Many reviewers praise the coverage, blendability, and long-lasting wear of the concealer.
Some reviewers complain the product is overpriced compared to buying it elsewhere.
A few reviewers report the shade oxidizes or dries out the skin.
Some reviewers note the shade ran lighter than expected or creased on them.
